label: openWithoutWindow: File > Open turns on with no window to open into
find: case "file.open": return hasWindow ? .available : .unavailable("Open a Design window first.")

label: fieldUndoIgnored: Undo follows the file's history while a field's own undo has focus
find: case "edit.undo": return field.map { $0.canUndo ? .available : .unavailable("Nothing to undo.") } ?? base(id)

label: renameOn: Rename Page… turns on though the menu has no name field
find: return .unavailable(w.addPageHelp ?? DesignRefusal.notBuilt("Renaming a page from the menu").help)

label: newFileGated: New File goes dark with no window, so nothing can start one
runSkipped: a menu item's run never reaches the catalog
historyWithoutWindow: View > Show History turns on with no window to show it in
find: availability: { $0.hasWindow ? .available : .unavailable("Open a Design window to see its history.") }

label: historyUnlisted: the menu never finds the window's History spec
